symptom: Background task or MCP stdio server stays in Status: RUNNING with 'No log output recorded yet' indefinitely.
root_cause: stdio MCP servers read stdin forever waiting for JSON-RPC messages unless stdin is closed with EOF; piped stdout/stderr is block-buffered (4KB-8KB) by default.
golden_rule: Never invoke a stdio MCP server bare without piping a JSON-RPC request + EOF; always set PYTHONUNBUFFERED=1 / line_buffering=True and emit an immediate [START] heartbeat log with flush=True.
verification_hook: Verify process exits within 3s when probing or emits [START] line within 100ms.

symptom: Piping inline scripts via @'...'@ | python - corrupts Vietnamese diacritics and Unicode symbols into '?' or mojibake.
root_cause: PowerShell encodes stdin pipes to native executables using the legacy Windows OEM/CP1252 codepage unless OutputEncoding is explicitly UTF-8.
golden_rule: Never pipe raw non-ASCII scripts through PowerShell stdin; always write helper scripts to a UTF-8 file or use explicit \uXXXX escapes with encoding='utf-8'.

symptom: The filename or extension is too long (WinError 206) when executing inline python -c scripts.
root_cause: Win32 CreateProcessW enforces a strict 32,767-character limit on lpCommandLine.
golden_rule: Write any automation script exceeding 2,000 characters to a scratch .py file and execute python scratch/script.py.

symptom: PIL.ImageGrab.grab() raises OSError: screen grab failed or captures a blank frame in background sessions.
root_cause: Desktop DC BitBlt fails in non-interactive or background shell sessions.
golden_rule: Use Win32 PrintWindow(hwnd, memDC, PW_RENDERFULLCONTENT=2) + GetDIBits directly against the window HWND.
verification_hook: Captured image size matches window rect and pixel variance > 0.

symptom: Application freezes for 5s-60s on startup or tab switch when ADB or network endpoints stall.
root_cause: Synchronous subprocess calls (adb devices) executed directly on the main UI thread.
golden_rule: Zero subprocess calls on the UI thread; UI reads 0ms in-memory cache while daemon worker threads poll with short timeouts (2s-4s) and push updates via root.after(0).
verification_hook: cProfile shows 0 calls to subprocess.Popen on main thread during __init__ and tab navigation.

symptom: 10s-30s startup lag and high RAM/VRAM usage before any task is triggered.
root_cause: Eager top-level torch imports and repeated instantiation of GPU/OCR engines across multiple subagents.
golden_rule: Enforce Singleton (__new__) on heavy engines and lazy load subagents/models via __getattr__ or @property on first actual task execution.

symptom: Device inspection takes 2s-4s per device due to 8 sequential adb shell getprop calls.
root_cause: Process spawn + ADB socket handshake adds 150ms-300ms overhead per invocation.
golden_rule: Batch multiple shell queries into a single invocation and cache static hardware properties per device serial.
verification_hook: Single adb shell call per device inspection.

symptom: Right-aligned header buttons or RAM/CPU badges get clipped when left/center elements grow.
root_cause: In Tkinter pack(), widgets packed earlier claim space priority over widgets packed later.
golden_rule: Always pack fixed right-hand controls (side=RIGHT) BEFORE packing expandable center/left controls (side=LEFT, expand=True).
verification_hook: All header badges and buttons remain 100% visible at minimum window width (1200px).

symptom: Periodic UI lag spikes every 2s and slow theme/language switching across 12 tabs.
root_cause: Unconditional widget .config() calls on unchanged polling data and recursive traversal of hidden tabs.
golden_rule: Cache widget state tuples (diff-checking) before calling .config(), and style only the active tab while marking hidden tabs dirty for on-demand styling.

symptom: Multi-byte color emojis render as '?', '[]', or ugly ASCII fallbacks ('*', '+').
root_cause: Tcl/Tk 8.6 on Windows only renders BMP Unicode codepoints (U+0000 to U+FFFF) reliably.
golden_rule: Use strictly BMP geometric glyphs supported by Segoe UI: ● (\u25cf), ○ (\u25cb), ▸ (\u25b8), ■ (\u25a0), ◐ (\u25d0), ▾ (\u25be), ▴ (\u25b4), → (\u2192), ✓ (\u2713).
verification_hook: Zero '?', '[]', or '* View' strings in widget labels.

symptom: Removing a function call line via str.replace leaves an empty try/if block and triggers IndentationError.
root_cause: Blind line deletion without preserving block body validity.
golden_rule: Replace removed standalone statements with 'pass' at the same indentation and run py_compile immediately.
verification_hook: python -m py_compile passes with exit code 0.

symptom: Running pytest leaves modified tracked files in config/*.json and reports/*.md.
root_cause: Tests mutate production singleton config paths instead of isolated temp paths or restoring state.
golden_rule: Isolate test state via tmp_path or reset state after test suites so git status remains clean.
verification_hook: git status -s is clean after test run.
